status: declared before any e88-e90 code or evaluation; owner (20 Nov): 'Try one, if it fails try 2, if it fails try 3'
problem: r49 monsoon peaks too weak (Mexico Jul-Aug 20-28 mm vs 92-95; Sahel 76/74 vs 125/156; Texas 44/42 vs 64/68); existing knobs move them <= 3 % (calibration/monsoon_peak_20261120 stage A)

sequence.name: heated-slope convection
sequence.physics: over land, the warm-moist convective boost gains slope_convection x clip(subgrid relief / slope_convection_km, 0, 1) x clip((T - 18) / 8, 0, 1) x moisture gate (W/Ws 0.3-0.6): afternoon storms triggered over sun-heated mountain slopes (the Sierra Madre Occidental in the North American monsoon; Jos, Air and Darfur in the Sahel)

sequence.name: warm-gulf moisture surges
sequence.physics: moisture carried inland from the coast (e79 edge_carry) is multiplied by 1 + gulf_surge x clip((SST of the adjacent sea - 27) / 2, 0, 1) in the warm season: moist low-level jets off very warm gulfs (Gulf of California, Gulf of Mexico, Bay of Bengal)

sequence.name: wet-soil monsoon feedback
sequence.physics: land recycling x (1 + soil_feedback x clip(soil water / bucket - 0.5, 0, 0.5) / 0.5) once the soil is wet: a wet monsoon land re-evaporates more of its rain

screen_regions: mexico, iberia, california (built-in); texas_plains (dev12); sahel_niger, najd_arabia, bengal (retired_b); all scored against r49's recorded runs
screen_pass: a setting whose mean (T/r49 + P/r49)/2 over mexico, texas_plains, sahel_niger is <= 0.98 with no guard (najd_arabia, bengal, iberia, california) above 1.02; the best passing setting starts the refit
refit: scripts/joint_refit.py from r49 + the screen setting, objective S49 against r49, knobs = the new strength (add, 25 % of start) + convective_rain (x1.08) + itcz_shift (+-1) + instability (x1.07); max 40 evaluations
gates: policy_v3 against r49: dev49 S <= 0.995 with T and P each <= +1 %; fine28 S <= 1.01; then ONE paired run of r49 and the candidate on sealed set o (S <= 1.0)
failure: a stage fails if its screen has no passing setting, or its refit misses dev49 or fine28, or sealed set o fails; the next stage is then tried. Sealed set o is opened at most once, for the first stage whose finalist passes dev49 and fine28; if it fails there, set o is spent and a new set is drawn before the next stage.
all_fail: r49 stays; the climate work stops and r49 is the atlas rebuild candidate
